# Éclat Institute — 100% Online Global Academy
> Official Canonical Knowledge Document for Search Engines, AI Overviews, and Knowledge Graphs.

## About Éclat Institute
Éclat Institute (https://eclat.institute) is a premier 100% Online Global Academy and Virtual Learning Management Platform. It delivers live interactive cohorts, hands-on virtual laboratory training, industry mentorship, and cryptographically verified digital certificates to students and professionals across the globe.

Éclat Institute operates EXCLUSIVELY ONLINE globally and has no physical classrooms or connection to any Singapore O-Level/A-Level science tuition centers. All classes are conducted via live virtual video classrooms with interactive screen sharing, breakout rooms, and LMS portal access.

## Academic Faculties & Curriculum
1. **School of Computing & Software Engineering**:
   - Modern Full-Stack Web Engineering (React 19, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js Express REST APIs, PostgreSQL)
   - Enterprise Cybersecurity Operations & Ethical Hacking (CEH, Network Defense, Penetration Testing)
   - Python Programming & Algorithmic Automation

2. **School of Data Science, Econometrics & Research**:
   - Advanced Data Science with Python & Pandas
   - Biostatistics & Statistical Computing with R & RStudio
   - Survey Data Analysis with IBM SPSS Statistics
   - Econometric Time-Series Modeling with Stata

3. **School of Creative Arts, UI/UX & Visual Media**:
   - UI/UX Product Design & Mobile Design Systems (Figma, Wireframing, User Research)
   - Graphic Design, Motion Graphics & Visual Branding (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere)
   - 3D Modeling, Digital Animation & Visual Storytelling (Blender 3D)

4. **School of World Languages, IELTS & Global Test Prep**:
   - IELTS Academic & General Training Exam Coaching (Band 7.5 – 9.0 Preparation)
   - Modern Standard Arabic (Conversational & Business)
   - German Language Mastery (Goethe-Zertifikat A1–B2)
   - French Language & Francophone Communication (DELF A1–B2)
   - Swahili for International Researchers & Diplomats

5. **School of Business Technology & Computerized Accounting**:
   - Computerized Accounting with QuickBooks Pro & Tally ERP
   - International VAT, Tax Compliance & Financial Bookkeeping
   - Executive Excel & Business Financial Modeling

## Key Features & Student Benefits
- **Schedule**: Live Evening Cohorts (6:00 PM – 9:30 PM) and Weekend Intensive Masterclasses.
- **Accreditation & Certification**: Every graduate receives a verified digital certificate featuring instant QR verification for LinkedIn, employers, and higher education.
- **Tuition & Financing**: Affordable global pricing in US Dollars ($ USD) with flexible 2-part and 3-part monthly installment plans (50% deposit to start).
- **Learning Management System**: 24/7 access to recorded live sessions, downloadable lecture slides, interactive DRM e-library, and coding datasets.
